scientific_integrity.claim_domain: Symmetric, entrywise nonnegative, row-stochastic Markov transitions supported on the cycle and antipodal edges of the Möbius ladder with \(2n\) vertices, every integer \(n\ge4\); unrestricted individual-edge weights.
limitations: No claim of unrestricted optimizer uniqueness.
SLEM is not the same objective as finite-time total-variation mixing time.
A February 2003 technical report appears in archival listings without a verified exact public-release day; 2004-10-29 is the earliest precisely day-verified source-release date used here.
Independent mathematical audit not performed; specialised literature may remain undiscovered.
scientific_integrity.main_result: Exact global minimum of second-largest eigenvalue modulus and a unique rotational/reflection-invariant optimizer; proof by Fourier modes, sharp positive-weighted three-constraint dual bound and endpoint verification.
scientific_integrity.verification: Analytical all-size proof; executable Fourier, eigenvalue, LP, dual and parity checks in verify.py, reproduced locally.

title: Parity-sharp fastest mixing on Möbius ladders
